name: Daily Drama: The Absolute Unit
author: Daily Drama
description: Sirocco ships a trillion-parameter open-weights model. The weights arrive at the end of the month. Which month is unclear.

add.title: Sirocco Ships an Absolute Unit
add.body:
Zephyr Absolute Unit: one trillion parameters, 49 billion awake. API only for now.
The open weights are due "end of the month". The torrent seeders are refreshing.

effects.text: {lab} answers trillion-parameter rival with Frontier-Chonkier; parameter count 'big, trust us'

choices.label: Promise our weights "end of next month"

effects.text: {lab} pledges open weights 'end of next month', outdoing Sirocco by one month
Day 4 at the tracker. 0 seeders. Morale: hopeful.

add.text: Sirocco releases trillion-parameter Zephyr Absolute Unit; open weights due 'end of the month', month not specified
Torrent community gathers outside Sirocco at 3am out of habit; leaves at dawn with nothing
Correction: Zephyr Absolute Unit has 49B active parameters. The other 951B are 'emotionally present'
'We are still in the race,' says Sirocco, from the API waitlist
Arena declares benchmarks saturated; models now graded on an armadillo in fishnet tights jaywalking on the moon
Open-ish AI responds to trillion-parameter model with Chatty Slightly Larger, shipping Thursday
Macrohard bundles Zephyr Absolute Unit into a single spreadsheet cell; cell now weighs 2TB
MetaMeta files trademark for 'Hefty Boi', promises it will be open, then closed, then hefty
One month later: Zephyr Absolute Unit weights now due 'end of the month' (a different month)
A trillion parameters, 49 billion awake. Same ratio as our team before coffee.
It's 3am. I'm refreshing the torrent tracker out of pure muscle memory.
Sirocco dropped something. Not the weights. Just... something.
We fell a place on the Arena. To a model named after a body type.
What if we add a trillion parameters and let most of them nap? Asking for the roadmap.
Nobody has ever called me chonky. They call me 'efficient'. It stings.
Great demo. But is it chonky? My partners are asking about chonk now.
OPEN WEIGHTS MEANS NOW. NOT 'END OF THE MONTH'.

override.tagline: Open weights. End of the month. Some month.
